opportunities.headline: Ship 'Weekly Etsy Shop Revenue Brief' agent — Stats paste-in → actions (not another spreadsheet)
opportunities.mapped_offer: Revenue Intel Agent — v5.1 (Etsy Shop Revenue Brief edition)
opportunities.why_now: Etsy Shop Stats already exposes visits, orders, revenue, conversion, and listing-level performance (S1); digital sellers are told to run weekly reviews but native Stats show gross revenue, not net after fees (S2, S3) — a brief agent closes the ritual gap without manual spreadsheet upkeep.
dependencies: Listing copy + 1-page 'paste from Shop Stats' guide
compliance_regimes: Etsy AI disclosure for listing copy — verify Seller Handbook at publish
opportunities.offer: Digital download: v5.1 prompt tuned for Etsy sellers + weekly brief template + validate_run.py lite instructions
opportunities.wedge: 10-minute weekly brief vs 12-tab spreadsheet maintenance (substitutes S5)
opportunities.moat: Evidence-gated v5.1 system + validator vs generic 'ChatGPT for Etsy' prompts
risks: Sellers skip paste step if onboarding unclear
mitigations: Ship SAMPLE brief in listing images
Price $22–27 sweet spot per prior market scan

assumption_basis.units: 22 Etsy sales in 90d (~1.7/wk) for new SKU with existing audience
assumption_basis.price_per_unit: Between large prompt bundle and mini system

evidence.claim_supported: Shop Stats provides visits, orders, revenue, conversion, listing stats
Digital sellers need weekly combined metrics review, not daily panic
Etsy dashboard lacks profit/margin visibility after fees

compliance_regimes: None applicable beyond marketplace ToS; include not-tax-advice disclaimer
opportunities.offer: Upsell PDF add-on or +$7 bundle tier
opportunities.wedge: Names the gap Stats Revenue vs net payout
opportunities.moat: Tied to v5.1 evidence rules — no invented fee totals

assumption_basis.units: 8 upsells to existing O1 buyers in 90d
